name: Janx II
description: Janx II was a gas giant located in the Janx system in the Prackla sector of the Expansion Region near the Inner Rim Territories. In 21 ABY, Boxer Point Station, a space station that functioned as a huge multipurpose port facility, was located in high orbit above Janx II.
